[b][size=xx-large][color=#ffffff][u]Hack Forum News - Edition 43[/u][/color][/size][/b]

[b]Welcome back to the Hack Forum News. Where we keep you up to date on the weekly events and news happening on site and around the world. If you have never heard of the Hack Forum News, don't worry, we have you covered. We are a team of members from the Hack Forums community who are journalists and writers, and we are here to keep you in the loop of the changes around the site and the events happening around the world.[/b]

[hr]

[img]https://hackforums.net/images/hfnews/headlines-red.png[/img]
[size=medium][b]Writer -[/b][/size] [mention=2331053]

[u][b][size=large][url=https://hackforums.net/showthread.php?tid=6318027][color=#ffffff]Guests View First Post Only[/color][/url][/size][/b][/u] By [mention=1]

Guests views. We have recently seen this in the news already, but the change has now been reverted to no longer allowing them to view threads. This change has happened due to the number of bots crawling threads. We at the HF News have noticed a very large number of threads getting 100's of guests views which raised questions around the change, but this has been reverted now due to many reasons mentioned within the thread.

[u][b][size=large][url=https://hackforums.net/showthread.php?tid=6323096][color=#ffffff]Upload Images Testing[/color][/url][/size][/b][/u] By [mention=1]

Over the last few weeks, we have seen a new feature added to the website around the new encrypted images being used, and this thread has been the testing ground for the new feature. From everyone testing the images on site, the feature seems to have been implemented well and everyone seems to be enjoying the new feature. If you are wanting to check it out or have not tried it yet, be sure to go and see what all the hype is about on the thread.

[u][b][size=large][url=https://hackforums.net/showthread.php?tid=6323084][color=#ffffff]Profile Redesign[/color][/url][/size][/b][/u] By [mention=1]

A change people have talked about for a while now is the current profile design. We have currently got two profiles on the site. One for the general account and one for the market side of the website. [mention=1] has stated they are looking to make a change to this by bringing them together in some way to allow these to all be on one screen instead of having two separate profiles, which can cause confusion between members on the site. Many members have pitched in a few different ways to make this happen. Go and see if you like any of the current ideas or maybe even share your own.

[u][b][size=large][url=https://hackforums.net/showthread.php?tid=6323141][color=#ffffff]Member Contest Rules & More[/color][/url][/size][/b][/u] By [mention=2331053]

A new thread making the Member Contests Rules much clearer has been published this week, which has made the pinned threads a far less of a mess and made everything a lot more clear for members who are looking to host or enter the new contests that have been popping up as of recently. With this new thread, it has summed up around three threads into one, and kept things short and simple to allow members who don't want to read too much but to understand the rules for the contests. If you have not seen the official post yet, be sure to check this one out.

[color=#C10300][b][size=15]Why Small Habits Shape Your Future[/size][/b][/color]  

Big goals often feel overwhelming, which is why many people struggle to stay consistent. The truth is, success is rarely about one big action—it’s about small habits repeated daily. Every time you choose discipline over comfort, you are shaping your future self. Whether it’s studying for 20 minutes, exercising briefly, or limiting distractions, these small actions build momentum. Over time, consistency turns into progress, and progress turns into results.
[hr]

[color=#7FDBFF][size=15]Advice of the week[/size][/color]  

Don’t focus on doing everything at once. Focus on doing something every day.
[hr]

[color=#008E02][size=15]Quote of the week[/size][/color]  
“Small disciplines repeated with consistency every day lead to great achievements.” — John C. Maxwell

[u][b][size=large][color=#ffffff][url=https://hackforums.net/showthread.php?tid=6321316]200$ Crypto Giveaway - CRACK THE SEED - Part 3[/url] By [mention=7] [/color][/size][/b][/u]

A giveaway has turned up from the legend himself [mention=7] last week. The giveaway is a little different to most. The giveaway is to whoever can crack the seed. Now what does this mean? We hear you ask. Well, this is like a puzzle giveaway where you will get 12 mnemonic words needed to access the wallet. The one who can complete them all wins the $200 SOL. If you think you have the skills for this, go and check out the thread for more details about how to obtain the first hints.

[u][b][size=large][color=#ffffff][url=https://hackforums.net/showthread.php?tid=6323089]$500 BTC Contest || 5 Winners $100 || Post to Enter || Ends April 14th[/url] By [mention=5744880] [/color][/size][/b][/u]

Five winners will be able to get $100 in BTC on the 14th of April next week. [mention=5744880] is hosting one of the bigger contests this year and one of the first to get rewarded with the Shining Knight award because of it. The requirements for the contest are that you just need to be at least L33t on the site and have 10 posts or more. This means everyone who is anyway can pretty much enter this easy giveaway and get rewarded with some easy bitcoin next week.

[u][b][size=large][color=#ffffff]MacBook alternatives from Asus Lenovo and Acer challenge Apple laptops[/color][/size][/b][/u]
New Windows laptops from Asus Lenovo and Acer are emerging as strong competitors to Apple MacBook models with improved performance design and battery efficiency.
[b][url=https://www.theverge.com/tech/908328/macbook-neo-windows-laptop-competitors-asus-lenovo-acer-review-comparison]Source[/url][/b]

[u][b][size=large][color=#ffffff]Insta360 launches snap on USB C camera for smartphones[/color][/size][/b][/u]
Insta360 introduced a compact snap on camera accessory that connects via USB C allowing users to capture higher quality photos using smartphone rear cameras.
[b][url=https://www.theverge.com/tech/907670/insta360-snap-usb-c-magsafe-screen-selfies-smartphone-rear-camera]Source[/url][/b]

[u][b][size=large][color=#ffffff]TSMC quarterly revenue jumps 35 percent beating market expectations[/color][/size][/b][/u]
TSMC reported a strong first quarter with revenue rising 35 percent year over year driven by continued demand for advanced chips used in artificial intelligence systems.
[b][url=https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/tsmcs-q1-revenue-jumps-35-yy-beats-market-forecast-2026-04-10/]Source[/url][/b]

[u][b][size=large][color=#ffffff]US officials warn banks about risks linked to Anthropic AI model[/color][/size][/b][/u]
US Treasury and Federal Reserve officials warned major banks about potential financial and operational risks tied to advanced AI systems such as Anthropic models.
[b][url=https://www.reuters.com/business/finance/bessent-powell-warn-bank-ceos-about-anthropic-model-risks-bloomberg-news-reports-2026-04-10/]Source[/url][/b]

[u][b][size=large][color=#ffffff]Chinese startup Shengshu raises 293 million dollars for artificial general intelligence[/color][/size][/b][/u]
Chinese AI startup Shengshu secured major funding to accelerate development of artificial general intelligence technologies and expand its research capabilities.
[b][url=https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/chinese-startup-shengshu-raises-293-million-advance-artificial-general-2026-04-10/]Source[/url][/b]

[u][b][size=large][color=#ffffff]Meta removes ads linked to social media addiction lawsuits[/color][/size][/b][/u]
Meta has removed advertising campaigns aimed at recruiting plaintiffs for lawsuits related to social media addiction concerns.
[b][url=https://www.reuters.com/sustainability/society-equity/meta-pulls-ads-aimed-recruiting-plaintiffs-social-media-addiction-lawsuits-2026-04-09/]Source[/url][/b]
